description: A polyphonic wavetable oscillator holding a cube of banks, waves and sample points, with morphing between them and a swarm mode that runs many detuned oscillators at once

params.text: How much of the exponential FM input reaches the pitch
Sets the modulation index of the linear FM input
Sets the level of the output
How much of the pulse width input reaches the pulse width
How much of the bank input reaches the choice of bank
How much of the wave input reaches the choice of wave
Switches the swarm on, so many oscillators run at once in place of one
How far apart in frequency the swarming oscillators are spread
How much of the swarm frequency input reaches the spread
How far apart in pulse width the swarming oscillators are spread
How much of the swarm pulse width input reaches the spread
How far apart across the banks the swarming oscillators are spread
How much of the swarm bank input reaches the spread
How far apart across the waves of the bank the swarming oscillators are spread
How much of the swarm wave input reaches the spread
Switches morphing on, so a change of bank or of wave slides from one to the next rather than jumping
Trims the tuning over plus or minus a semitone

inputs.text: A polyphonic pitch input at 1V per octave
A voltage modulating the pitch exponentially
A signal modulating the frequency linearly
A voltage moving the pulse width
A voltage picking the wave, which surfs along the waves of the bank
A voltage moving the frequency spread of the swarm
A voltage moving the pulse width spread of the swarm
A voltage moving the spread of the swarm across the banks
A voltage moving the spread of the swarm across the waves

outputs.text: One side of the stereo output

notes: the bank display is a control in its own right: it browses the banks like a book, or the waves inside the morphed bank, and dragging in its scale area changes how the waves are drawn
a base table of 64 banks of 64 waves of 256 points is loaded when the module is created, so it sounds before anything is imported
banks are loaded by dropping wav files or whole folders onto the module
menu: POINTS in WAVE — sets how many points a wave holds: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096 or 8192 points
REMOVE ALL BANKS — empties the cube, with LOAD BANK reading one in and SAVE ALL BANKS keeping what is loaded as the global bank a new module starts with
SWARMING VCOs COUNT — sets how many oscillators a swarm runs: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20 or 24 swarmers
STOP GRAPHIC ANIMATIONS — switches the moving displays off
WAVES in BANK — sets how many waves a bank holds: 8, 16, 32 or 64 waves; how many banks there are follows from that and from the points in a wave
POWER MODE — sets how hard the oscillator works: LOW POWER, MEDIUM POWER or HCF MODE
PROCESSING BLOCK SIZES — sets the block the oscillator computes in, from 16 samples up to 2048 samples
MULTITHREADED — runs the oscillator on an extra thread; on macOS it starts switched off
